title: Direct targeting of STAT3 by xanthatin suppresses allergic airway inflammation via inhibition of TSLP release and NK2 cell polarization.
authors: Bao, Kaifan; Zheng, Jie; Wang, Xiaotong; Zhou, Yijing; Chen, Yanyan; Yuan, Weiyuan; Yao, Lu; Wang, Siqi; Hong, Min
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄质素通过直接靶向STAT3蛋白抑制过敏性气道炎症，涉及分子对接但核心是药物-蛋白互作与免疫机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Xanthatin is a natural sesquiterpene lactone derived from Xanthium strumarium L. (cang-er-zi) in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), which has been reported with multiple pharmacological activities. Although the bioactivity of xanthatin against asthma is well recognized, the underlying mechanism lacks thorough research. AIM OF THE STUDY: To systematically investigate the therapeutic potential and mechanism of xanthatin ameliorating allergic airway inflammation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The alleviating capacity of xanthatin was evaluated on a 24-day house dust mite (HDM)-induced mice asthma model. Airway responsiveness was determined by detecting enhanced pause (penh) upon stimulation with different concentrations of methacholine chloride. IgE in serum, and protein levels of IL-4, IL-5, IL-13, IL-25, IL-33, thymic stromal lymphopoietin (TSLP) and IFN-gamma in lungs were detected by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). Lung histological changes were assessed after tissue slices were stained with haematoxylin and eosin (H&E). Changes of subsets of natural killer cells (NK) in mice peripheral blood and human NK92MI cell line were analyzed by flow cytometry. Anti-Asialo GM1 antibody was applied for the depletion of NK, and the key role of NK2 involved in asthma was determined by adoptive transfer. To validate the pivotal role of TSLP in inducing NK2 polarization, anti-TSLP monoclonal antibody was used. The signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) inhibitor stattic, alongside with flow cytometry and western blotting, was applied to analyze whether STAT3 activation was the indispensable part for TSLP to induce NK2 and bronchial epithelial cell to produce TSLP. Molecular docking, microscale thermophoresis (MST), and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays were applied to test the direct binding of xanthatin to STAT3. RESULTS: Xanthatin administration significantly alleviated hallmark asthmatic features, including airway hyperresponsiveness, eosinophilia, elevated serum IgE and high levels of Th2 cytokines in airway, and lung tissue pathological changes. Flow cytometry analysis revealed that xanthatin specifically reduced the lung accumulation of IL-13-producing NK2, but not IFN-gamma(+) NK1. Depletion of NK cells and adoptive transfer of NK2 cells confirmed the pivotal role of NK2 cells in driving the pathology and in mediating xanthatin's protective effects. Mechanistically, xanthatin selectively suppressed bronchial epithelial cell-derived TSLP both in vivo and in vitro. We identified TSLP as a novel inducer of STAT3-dependent NK2 cell differentiation, which was inhibited by xanthatin. Furthermore, xanthatin directly bound to STAT3 protein with high affinity. Consequently, xanthatin inhibited STAT3 phosphorylation in both bronchial epithelial cells (suppressing TSLP production) and in NK cells (impairing TSLP-induced NK2 differentiation). CONCLUSIONS: Xanthatin ameliorates allergic airway inflammation by directly targeting STAT3, thereby dually inhibiting the TSLP/STAT3 axis in epithelial cells and the subsequent STAT3-dependent differentiation of pathogenic NK2 cells, presenting a promising multi-targeted strategy for asthma treatment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：苍耳亭（Xanthatin）是一种源自传统中药（TCM）中苍耳子（Xanthium strumarium L.，cang-er-zi）的天然倍半萜内酯，已被报道具有多种药理活性。尽管苍耳亭对哮喘的生物活性已得到广泛认可，但其潜在机制缺乏深入研究。研究目的：系统研究苍耳亭改善过敏性气道炎症的治疗潜力及其机制。材料与方法：在为期24天的屋尘螨（HDM）诱导的小鼠哮喘模型中评估苍耳亭的缓解能力。通过检测不同浓度氯化甲胆碱刺激下的增强呼气间歇（penh）来确定气道反应性。采用酶联免疫吸附测定（ELISA）检测血清中IgE以及肺组织中IL-4、IL-5、IL-13、IL-25、IL-33、胸腺基质淋巴细胞生成素（TSLP）和IFN-γ的蛋白水平。组织切片经苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色后评估肺组织学变化。通过流式细胞术分析小鼠外周血和人NK92MI细胞系中自然杀伤细胞（NK）亚群的变化。应用抗Asialo GM1抗体耗竭NK细胞，并通过过继转移确定NK2在哮喘中的关键作用。为验证TSLP在诱导NK2极化中的关键作用，使用了抗TSLP单克隆抗体。应用信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）抑制剂stattic，结合流式细胞术和蛋白质印迹法，分析STAT3激活是否是TSLP诱导NK2及支气管上皮细胞产生TSLP所必需的部分。采用分子对接、微量热泳动（MST）和表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验检测苍耳亭与STAT3的直接结合。结果：苍耳亭给药显著缓解了哮喘的标志性特征，包括气道高反应性、嗜酸性粒细胞增多、血清IgE升高、气道中Th2细胞因子水平升高以及肺组织病理变化。流式细胞术分析显示，苍耳亭特异性减少肺中产生IL-13的NK2细胞积累，但不影响IFN-γ(+) NK1细胞。NK细胞耗竭和NK2细胞过继转移实验证实了NK2细胞在驱动病理及介导苍耳亭保护效应中的关键作用。机制上，苍耳亭在体内和体外均选择性抑制支气管上皮细胞来源的TSLP。我们鉴定TSLP为STAT3依赖性NK2细胞分化的新型诱导剂，而苍耳亭可抑制该过程。此外，苍耳亭以高亲和力直接结合STAT3蛋白。因此，苍耳亭抑制支气管上皮细胞（抑制TSLP产生）和NK细胞（损害TSLP诱导的NK2分化）中的STAT3磷酸化。结论：苍耳亭通过直接靶向STAT3改善过敏性气道炎症，从而双重抑制上皮细胞中的TSLP/STAT3轴及随后的致病性NK2细胞STAT3依赖性分化，为哮喘治疗提供了一种有前景的多靶点策略。
